turns.speaker: SPK_A
turns.text: Good morning everyone, thanks for joining the weekly sync. I want to start with the deployment status before we move on to anything else.

turns.speaker: SPK_B
turns.text: The rollout finished last night, and all three regions are reporting green.

turns.speaker: SPK_D
turns.text: I still see one alert sitting on the Berlin cluster, though.

turns.speaker: SPK_D
turns.text: Disk pressure on the build node. It has been climbing steadily since Friday afternoon.

turns.speaker: SPK_A
turns.text: That will be the log volume again.

turns.speaker: SPK_C
turns.text: I can clean up the stale artifacts this afternoon and reclaim most of it.

turns.speaker: SPK_D
turns.text: While you are in there, please check the retention policy too.

turns.speaker: SPK_A
turns.text: Great. Then let us move on to the next item, which is the tokenizer migration and what it means for the release train.
